 The Township of Livingston has issued the following press release about Daylight Savings Time: 
 As the leaves change from green to gold and brown, and the daylight hours start to get shorter, it is time to roll back the clocks. On Sunday, Nov. 1, the clocks go back one hour, signaling the end of Daylight Saving Time. It should also prompt the change of batteries in smoke alarms and carbon monoxide detectors, and the inspection of fire extinguishers.
